blocks.content: A linear gradient creates a smooth transition between two or more colors along a straight line.
To apply a linear gradient, use the linear-gradient() function, specifying the direction and colors you want to blend.
In this example, linear-gradient(to right, blue, green) creates a linear gradient that starts with blue on the left and smoothly transitions to green on the right.
